basis: FOLD-ARCHIVE-SIGN: binding for scripts/factory-archive-sign.py. The containers are the fold-rango-factory-v1 bootstrap profile's (os/signing-bootstrap/profiles.json). keyVersion/passphraseVersion come only from that bootstrap's committed public receipt (bootstrap names os/retained-rango/factory-signing-bootstrap-receipt.json with its sha256; scripts/factory-archive-sign.py bind prints the exact values, and check cross-checks project, signer, secrets, the measured ssh-keygen and the flavor principal against the named profile); sshKeygen only from a measured installed identity on the builder; the public identity only from os/flavors/rango.json factorySigning (Flavors), bound from the same receipt. While any value is null, check exits 4 and sign refuses before any host or secret access. Nothing here is a key, secret or credential.
